title: U.S. Rapid Panel Resistance Marker Concordance Benchmark
description:
An open isolate-level dataset pairing NCBI AMRFinderPlus resistance gene calls with submitted laboratory susceptibility results for U.S. human clinical isolates of Staphylococcus aureus, Enterococcus faecalis, Enterococcus faecium and the Enterobacterales. Genes are mapped to the targets rapid blood culture panels report (mecA, mecC, vanA, vanB, KPC, NDM, OXA-48-like, VIM, IMP, CTX-M). MICs and zone diameters are reinterpreted against CLSI M100 (35th ed., 2025) breakpoints, and PPV, NPV, sensitivity and specificity with Wilson 95% intervals are reported by gene, drug and organism, for all specimens and for blood and sterile-site isolates. Includes the codebook, provenance log (source URLs, access dates, SHA-256 fingerprints, row counts, terms of use) and the full code to rebuild it.

Gene calls from assembled genomes stand in for panel results; this is not an evaluation of any commercial device. See LIMITATIONS.md.
